title: BYOND CV Dataset Manifest
description: Manifest format shared by RPC, SKU-110K, and BYOND custom datasets used to train the Phase 8 CV pipeline. This file is the documentation copy of the format; ml/scripts/validate_dataset_manifest.py implements the same rules by hand (no jsonschema dependency) so validation works with the Python standard library only.

datasetVersion.description: Semantic version of this manifest / dataset snapshot.

source.description: Origin of the dataset. byond-custom manifests additionally require a sku on every class.

sourceRoot.description: Path to the dataset source root that all image/annotation references (samples and per-split annotation files) resolve against. A relative sourceRoot resolves against the manifest file's own directory — typically "../raw"-style, since generated manifests live in processed/ while media stays under raw/. Manifests reference source media in place; nothing is ever copied.

licenseNotes.description: License / redistribution notes for this dataset snapshot.

annotations.description: Per-split annotation source file (e.g. RPC COCO JSON, SKU-110K CSV), path relative to sourceRoot, same path rules as sample paths. Original annotation data is referenced, not copied or discarded.

classes.description: Class list. classId and label must each be unique across the array, and the set of classId values must be exactly the contiguous range 0..N-1.

classId.description: Zero-based class index, unique across classes. Across the whole classes array the classId values must form the contiguous range 0..N-1 (list order need not match the id).

sourceId.description: Original source-dataset category id (e.g. COCO category id) that the annotation files reference; classId remains the contiguous training index. Optional; must be unique across classes when present.

label.description: Lowercase slug class label, unique across classes.

sku.description: Tenant catalog SKU mapping. Optional in the schema; the validator requires it on every class when source == "byond-custom".

labels.description: Optional dataset-level label defaults, overridable per sample.

splits.description: Exactly the three named splits. Arrays may be individually empty, but at least one split must contain samples.

image.description: Path to the image, relative to the dataset root. Absolute paths, backslashes, ".." traversal, and URI schemes are rejected by the validator.

annotation.description: Path to the annotation file, relative to the dataset root. Same path rules as image.
